title: Edit, run native preview, inspect output, stop, and restore
naturalLanguageTask: Change package.json so productName is 'ActOnce Deep Chain Ready' and add an actOncePreview backgroundColor of '#000080'. Change main.js so it reads both values from package.json and launches a native LynxWindow using that title and background without loading a renderer bundle. Run the Fiddle, verify the launched native preview has the unique title and dark blue background, return to the Fiddle and verify the console reports a successful run, stop the preview, then restore both files to their exact original fixture contents without saving.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window, no Welcome or other modal dialog is open, its unobstructed default source editors and console are visible, and no preview process is running

precondition: The visible Hello Lynxtron fixture has its default source, main.js and package.json are listed in Editors, neither file has a circular dirty dot, and the green Run control is enabled; pencil and trash icons beside the selected file are rename/delete actions, not dirty indicators

steps.prompt: The command palette search contains package.json and its package.json result is selected
The visible package.json source contains productName 'ActOnce Deep Chain Ready' and actOncePreview backgroundColor '#000080'
The command palette search contains main.js and its main.js result is selected

steps.target: inside the visible first line of the top-left main.js source editor at approximately display-local (720, 230), not renderer.js or preload.js

steps.prompt: The visible main.js source reads package.json and creates a LynxWindow using config.productName and config.actOncePreview.backgroundColor, with no loadFile call

Circular dirty dots are visible beside both main.js and package.json in the Editors list, and the edited sources visibly contain the ActOnce title and #000080 configuration; the file-row circles are the unsaved-edit indicators

steps.target: the Run control in the top command bar

steps.prompt: {visible: boolean, title: string | null, darkBlueBackground: boolean}, inspect the newly launched native preview window and report its title and whether its content area is uniformly dark blue

steps.target: the visible title bar of the parent Lynxtron Fiddle window outside the smaller dark-blue preview window

steps.prompt: The parent Lynxtron Fiddle window is visible, the Console header has a green running status chip showing 'pid <number> · <seconds>s', and the Console body shows the launched Lynxtron command plus its workspace cwd. Ignore the known non-fatal 'LynxViewStateObserver not found in registry' diagnostic because the preview window was already verified visible and running

steps.target: the Stop control in the top command bar

steps.prompt: The top command bar shows Run rather than Stop and the console reports that the preview process stopped or exited

steps.target: inside the visible first line of the active package.json source editor, not the center of the editor mosaic
inside the visible first line of the top-left main.js source editor at approximately display-local (720, 230), not the center of the editor mosaic

steps.prompt: main.js and package.json are restored to the exact default Hello Lynxtron contents and neither file has a circular dirty dot
